newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Banca Quadrum Q4 net 68,000 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Banca Quadrum Q4 net 68,000 pesos.

text.p: Banca Quadrum said on Wednesday it had a 68,000 peso net profit in the fourth quarter of last year and a 340,000 peso full-year profit under U.S. GAAP accounting principles. It gave no comparative figures.
In a statement it said it made provisions against unrecoverable loans of 4.5 million pesos during the final quarter and 17.2 million pesos during the year.
Its net past-due loan ratio fell to 9.6 percent, while its capitalization index to Dec. 31 was 12 percent.

It said deposits continued to rise. By the end of the year deposits from more than 1,500 clients accounted for more than 60 percent of the consolidated debt of the company, a 13 percent increase from September 1996.
The average maturity of its deposits was 41.6 days. It said it was one of the few banks granting new credits.
Quadrum also noted it was splitting from FerroQuadrum.
